description: This file contains implementation of functions related to creating and setting up a quantized fully-connected (linear) layer in QNNPACK, specifically for 8-bit unsigned integer quantization. It includes functions to create the operator with proper parameters, allocate memory, pack weights, and configure execution parameters for inference.

methods.description: Configures a fully connected operator for a specific batch size and data layout, preparing for execution.
